answer: Each registration gets a VRF-selected slot in the garden registry and must finish five sequential Argon2 rounds within 30 minutes. In each round, identities sharing a funding nullifier use 4, 6, 8, ... GiB in registration order. A seven-member ridge committee checks traces against the seed from the umber beacon; four signatures activate an account. Thus n linked Sybils cost 5n(n+3) GiB-rounds, and slot-bound traces cannot be replayed.
